builds.name: Reference: Engage and rescue
builds.goal: Reference for Alistar: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A frontline initiator and bodyguard who chains displacement into a delayed attack stun, using his ultimate to remain in melee. Can AP repay damage from Q/W/E while preserving a real engage and R survival window? E stun needs contact and an attack; score allied follow-up separately. A support quest and protective actives test allied survival after an engage.
builds.summary: A support quest and protective actives test allied survival after an engage.
testPlan: Kit question for Alistar: Can AP repay damage from Q/W/E while preserving a real engage and R survival window? E stun needs contact and an attack; score allied follow-up separately.

Start with the early core (Support quest, boots and Locket; choose later actives by threat) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use real support income and keep the quest/vision slot.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: A support quest and protective actives test allied survival after an engage. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Alistar smashes the ground, dealing damage to nearby enemies and tossing them into the air. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Low income rarely reaches six items; Mikael does not remove airborne/suppression.

tradeoffs: Low income rarely reaches six items; Mikael does not remove airborne/suppression.

The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Support quest, boots and Locket; choose later actives by threat. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.

Enemy champion and epic jungle monster deaths fully charge this Ability.

At [5] stacks, Alistar's next Attack against champions Stuns for [1] second and deals an additional [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=20, perLevel=15, changes=[])] magic damage.

builds.name: Trample spellblade brawler
builds.summary: Make the delayed Trample stun a damage delivery window.
builds.goal: Make the delayed Trample stun a damage delivery window.
builds.hypothesis: Trample deals 0.7 AP magic damage over five seconds and requires five champion-damaging pulses before the stunning attack. Dusk and Dawn gives that actual attack a magic Spellblade payload; Riftmaker rewards staying in combat and R's seven-second reduction helps survive the wait. Rylai's slow may keep enemies near E.
testPlan: Required state: Need close contact for five E stacks, R available and an attack after the charge.
Record time to stun and damage over an E cycle against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Headbutting the target away or being kited interrupts E stacking; low spell ranks limit damage.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: The E stun's bonus damage has a level expression, not an AP ratio.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Dusk and Dawn, Riftmaker, Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Spirit Visage, Abyssal Mask, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.

builds.name: Roar health battery
builds.summary: Convert accumulated health into repeated team healing.
builds.goal: Convert accumulated health into repeated team healing.
builds.hypothesis: Triumphant Roar restores 5% max health to Alistar and 1.4 times that to nearby allies at seven stacks. Heartsteel health increases the documented base heal, while Moonstone chains allied healing and Redemption supports the clustered formation. Q/W disruptions and nearby deaths provide real stacks, rather than attack speed directly accelerating Roar.
